name: Kuntz HoLEP versus open prostatectomy
question: How do holmium laser enucleation and transvesical open prostatectomy compare in obstructed men with prostates larger than 100 g?

arms.label: Holmium laser enucleation of the prostate

design.population: 120 men with symptomatic, urodynamically confirmed obstruction and prostate volume at least 100 mL on transrectal ultrasonography.
design.locator: Full text, Materials and methods, p 161; primary PubMed abstract, Materials and Methods

verdictNote: Voiding improvements were similar; HoLEP reduced perioperative morbidity; five-year outcomes used completers.
takeaway: In obstructed men with prostates larger than 100 g, holmium laser enucleation and transvesical open prostatectomy produced similar six-month voiding improvements; enucleation had less blood loss, shorter catheterization and hospitalization, and fewer transfusions, but longer operating time.
